# Source: nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max: # Adapted for wisp-design: schema condensed to 6 columns; web stacks only.
# Sample shipped in Phase 4 — full corpus lands in Phase 7. See skills/data/corpus/README.md.
# CAUTION: this style is a11y-hostile by default. Foreground tokens here are DARK enough for WCAG AA
# against the pale ground — never thin the contrast further. Opt-in only; see directions/soft-neumorphic.md.

column3: Primary button — extruded, dual-shadow, soft pressed-in on active
column4: padding: 14px 28px; background: var(--sn-ground); color: var(--sn-fg); border: none; border-radius: 16px; font-weight: 600; box-shadow: -6px -6px 12px var(--sn-shadow-light), 6px 6px 12px var(--sn-shadow-dark); transition: box-shadow 150ms ease-out;
column5: ☐ AA contrast on fg ☐ active state inverts to inset-shadow ☐ visible focus ring (outline-offset) ☐ 44x44 touch min

column4: background: var(--sn-ground); box-shadow: inset -4px -4px 8px var(--sn-shadow-light), inset 4px 4px 8px var(--sn-shadow-dark);
column5: ☐ same ground as resting state ☐ shadow direction reverses ☐ no jump in size ☐ transition <200ms

column3: Feature card — extruded soft surface, generous padding
column4: padding: 32px; background: var(--sn-ground); border-radius: 24px; box-shadow: -8px -8px 16px var(--sn-shadow-light), 8px 8px 16px var(--sn-shadow-dark);
column5: ☐ no nested neumorphic surfaces ☐ fg color passes AA ☐ generous padding ≥24px ☐ never stack on dark ground

column3: Toggle — pill-shaped extruded, with sliding indicator
column4: width: 56px; height: 30px; background: var(--sn-ground); border-radius: 9999px; box-shadow: inset -3px -3px 6px var(--sn-shadow-light), inset 3px 3px 6px var(--sn-shadow-dark); position: relative;
column5: ☐ checked state visible without colour alone (also moves position) ☐ aria-checked attr ☐ keyboard activatable ☐ AA

column4: height: 8px; background: var(--sn-ground); border-radius: 9999px; box-shadow: inset -2px -2px 4px var(--sn-shadow-light), inset 2px 2px 4px var(--sn-shadow-dark);
column5: ☐ thumb is extruded (opposite to inset track) ☐ value label visible ☐ AA on label

column3: Range slider thumb — extruded, contrast accent
column4: width: 20px; height: 20px; background: var(--sn-ground); border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: -3px -3px 6px var(--sn-shadow-light), 3px 3px 6px var(--sn-shadow-dark); cursor: grab;
column5: ☐ visible focus ring offset from thumb ☐ cursor grab→grabbing on active

column3: Circular icon button — small extruded surface for tactile feel
column4: width: 44px; height: 44px; display: grid; place-items: center; background: var(--sn-ground); border-radius: 50%; box-shadow: -4px -4px 8px var(--sn-shadow-light), 4px 4px 8px var(--sn-shadow-dark); color: var(--sn-fg);
column5: ☐ icon stroke contrast AA ☐ 44x44 min target ☐ accessible label via aria

column4: padding: 12px 18px; background: var(--sn-ground); border: none; border-radius: 12px; color: var(--sn-fg); font-size: 16px; box-shadow: inset -3px -3px 6px var(--sn-shadow-light), inset 3px 3px 6px var(--sn-shadow-dark);
column5: ☐ font-size ≥16px (iOS) ☐ visible focus state (deepens inset) ☐ AA contrast on text

column3: Modal card — large extruded surface, ample padding
column4: padding: 40px; background: var(--sn-ground); border-radius: 28px; box-shadow: -12px -12px 24px var(--sn-shadow-light), 12px 12px 24px var(--sn-shadow-dark); max-width: 480px;
column5: ☐ focus-trap engaged ☐ ESC closes ☐ never nest neumorphic-on-neumorphic

column3: Status badge — small extruded pill, color via accent
column4: display: inline-flex; padding: 6px 14px; background: var(--sn-ground); border-radius: 9999px; color: var(--sn-accent); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; box-shadow: -2px -2px 4px var(--sn-shadow-light), 2px 2px 4px var(--sn-shadow-dark);
column5: ☐ accent color passes AA on ground ☐ semantic colour + text (not colour alone) ☐ tactile feel matches siblings

column3: Active tab — inset (pressed-in) state, inactive extruded
column4: padding: 12px 20px; background: var(--sn-ground); border-radius: 12px; color: var(--sn-fg); box-shadow: inset -3px -3px 6px var(--sn-shadow-light), inset 3px 3px 6px var(--sn-shadow-dark);
column5: ☐ aria-current applied ☐ inactive tabs extruded (positive shadow) ☐ AA contrast

column3: Loading spinner — soft pastel arc, reduced-motion friendly
column4: width: 32px; height: 32px; border: 3px solid var(--sn-shadow-dark); border-top-color: var(--sn-accent); border-radius: 50%; animation: spin 1.2s linear infinite;
column5: ☐ prefers-reduced-motion freezes ☐ aria-label set ☐ accent passes contrast

column3: Soft divider — inset hairline shadow, no border
column4: height: 6px; background: var(--sn-ground); border-radius: 9999px; box-shadow: inset -1px -1px 2px var(--sn-shadow-light), inset 1px 1px 2px var(--sn-shadow-dark); margin-block: 32px;
column5: ☐ aria-hidden if decorative ☐ never used as primary content separator

column3: Secondary button — flatter extrusion, lower emphasis
column4: padding: 12px 24px; background: var(--sn-ground); color: var(--sn-fg-muted); border: none; border-radius: 14px; font-weight: 500; box-shadow: -3px -3px 6px var(--sn-shadow-light), 3px 3px 6px var(--sn-shadow-dark);
column5: ☐ fg-muted still passes AA ☐ less shadow than primary ☐ no flat fallback

column3: Empty state — extruded card with centred copy and CTA
column4: padding: 48px 32px; background: var(--sn-ground); border-radius: 24px; box-shadow: -8px -8px 16px var(--sn-shadow-light), 8px 8px 16px var(--sn-shadow-dark); text-align: center;
column5: ☐ specific copy (no Lorem) ☐ accent CTA with AA contrast ☐ single primary action

column3: Tooltip — small extruded surface with arrow
column4: padding: 8px 12px; background: var(--sn-ground); border-radius: 8px; color: var(--sn-fg); font-size: 13px; box-shadow: -3px -3px 6px var(--sn-shadow-light), 3px 3px 6px var(--sn-shadow-dark);
column5: ☐ aria-describedby links source ☐ keyboard reachable (focus shows tooltip) ☐ AA contrast
